senses.gloss: (Saf. of ארך, cmp. סרג) to interweave, twist; trnsf. (corresp. to h. עָוַת) to confound; to wrong.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 3:59">Targ. Lam. III, 59</cite>; a. e. (interchanging with <cite ref="O01513"><he>סְרַב</he> II</cite>, q. v.).—
Pes. 51ᵃ, v. next w.—Part. pass. סָרִיךְ, f. סְרִיכָא; pl. סְרִיכִין; סְרִיכָן intricate, perverted.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 10:3">Targ. Koh. X, 3</cite>.
